Jules Park: Idea: make sampling decisions consider a per-route "redact_tier" budget and a per-request client hint header. Goal: cut down on full-payload captures on noisy routes but keep targeted inspect for canaries/owners
Nina Patel: Client hint name? `X-Redwood-Redact-Tier`? values like `none/partial/full`?
Jules Park: Exactly. SDKs set header. Server enforces max allowed by tenant policy; header is a hint not a permission.
Omar Khan: Security note: if clients can set `none`, we must HMAC sample ids and validate caller permissions before returning raw data. Attack surface otherwise.
Lina Gomez: Agreed. Also we should always emit telemetry (latency/token histograms) even when payloads are fully redacted so SLO tracking still works.
Jules Park: Implementation sketch: on request -> evaluate route policy -> calculate sampling_prob = clamp(route_budget / estimate_rate, 0, 1). Use sticky hashing on client_id to stabilize which clients get sampled. If sampled, attach sample record with `sample_tier`, `policy_snapshot`, `sample_id` (HMAC-signed).
Nina Patel: Dashboard UX: add per-route "Sampling burn" widget: budget remaining %, sparkline, recent sampled events (metadata only), and a small "Request unmask" button that opens an inspect ticket modal with TTL + justification field.
Omar Khan: For unmasking: console sends sample_id + signature -> server validates HMAC and checks policy + RBAC. If allowed, return raw once and log audit entry. No permanent storing of unmasked blob.
Kofi Mensah: Metrics to add: `sampling.budget_remaining`, `sampling.sticky_hit_rate`, `sampling.unmask.requests`, `sampling.unmask.approved`, `sampling.tokens_saved_estimate`. These help prove value to SRE.
Lina Gomez: Runbook: if route_budget < 3% auto-fallback to `full` redact for non-owner tokens and page on-call. Also expose a kill-switch flag in console to flip route to full redact immediately.
Jules Park: Pseudo-sample record: ```json
{
  "route": "/v1/chat",
  "sample_tier": "partial",
  "effective_policy": "quota-capped",
  "sample_id": "s_abc123",
  "sample_sig": "hmac:...",
  "sampled": true
}
```
Nina Patel: UX Q: does the inspect modal unmask immediately or create a ticket for approval? Proposal: create ticket with optional auto-approve for route owners; default requires approval. All ops actions logged.
Omar Khan: I'll draft the HMAC scheme and token validation flow. Recommend using tenant-specific key rotation and short-lived inspector tokens.
Jules Park: I'll own server sampler + sticky hash. Nina — console widget?
Nina Patel: Taking console work. Will mock with design system components.
deploy-bot: CI started for branch `feat/route-sampler-redact-tier` (build 513). Tests running. :rocket:
Kofi Mensah: Nice. Can we aim for a minimal proto next sprint: header parse, budget calc, sticky sampler, and readonly dashboard?
Jules Park: Yep. I'll open RFC with policy schema examples and expected metrics. Leaving SDK note: default header value = `partial` and docs for opt-in `none` for owners.
